name: ThreeDFormat
remarks: You cannot apply three-dimensional formatting to some kinds of shapes, such as beveled shapes or multiple-disjoint paths. Most of the properties and methods of the ThreeDFormat object for such a shape will fail.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

Set myShape = myDocument.Shapes _
    .AddShape(msoShapeOval, 90, 90, 90, 40)

With myShape.ThreeD
    .Visible = True
    .Depth = 50
    'RGB value for purple
    .ExtrusionColor.RGB = RGB(255, 100, 255)
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: Returns or sets the depth of the shape's extrusion. Read/write.

properties.name: ExtrusionColor
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color of the shape's extrusion. Read-only.

properties.name: ExtrusionColorType
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the extrusion color is based on the extruded shape's fill (the front face of the extrusion) and automatically changes when the shape's fill changes, or whether the extrusion color is independent of the shape's fill. Read/write.

properties.name: Perspective
properties.description: Determines whether the extrusion appears in perspective. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetExtrusionDirection
properties.description: Returns the direction that the extrusion's sweep path takes away from the extruded shape (the front face of the extrusion). Read-only.

properties.name: PresetLightingDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the light source relative to the extrusion. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetLightingSoftness
properties.description: Returns or sets the intensity of the extrusion lighting. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetMaterial
properties.description: Returns or sets the extrusion surface material. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetThreeDFormat
properties.description: Returns the preset extrusion format. Read-only.

properties.name: RotationX
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the x-axis, in degrees. Read/write.

properties.name: RotationY
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the extruded shape around the y-axis, in degrees. Read/write.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets the visibility of the specified object or the formatting applied to the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetLighting
properties.description: Returns or sets the effects lighting used by the specified ThreeDFormat object. Read/write.

properties.name: Z
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance the specified ThreeDFormat object is moved away from the ground plane, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelTopType
properties.description: Returns or set the top bevel type. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelTopInset
properties.description: Returns or sets the top bevel inset for the specified ThreeDFormat object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelTopDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets the top bevel height for the specified ThreeDFormat object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelBottomType
properties.description: Returns or set the bottom bevel type. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelBottomInset
properties.description: Returns or sets the bottom bevel inset for the specified ThreeDFormat object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: BevelBottomDepth
properties.description: Returns or sets the bottom bevel height for the specified ThreeDFormat object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: PresetCamera
properties.description: Returns the effects camera type used by the specified ThreeDFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: RotationZ
properties.description: Returns or sets the rotation of the effects camera for the specified ThreeDFormat object, in degrees. Read/write.

properties.name: ContourWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the contour around the specified ThreeDFormat object, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: ContourColor
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color of the specified ThreeDFormat object's contour. Read-only.

properties.name: FieldOfView
properties.description: Returns or sets the camera field of view for the specified ThreeDFormat object, in degrees. Read/write.

properties.name: ProjectText
properties.description: Specifies whether text on the specified ThreeDFormat object rotates with the object. Read/write.

properties.name: LightAngle
properties.description: Sets or returns the angle at which light impacts the shape whose three-dimensional format is represented by the specified object. Read/write.

methods.name: IncrementRotationX
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the x-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the x-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape up; a negative value tilts it down.

methods.name: IncrementRotationY
methods.description: Changes the rotation of the specified shape around the y-axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: Specifies how much (in degrees) the rotation of the shape around the y-axis is to be changed. Can be a value from -90 through 90. A positive value tilts the shape to the left; a negative value tilts it to the right.

methods.name: ResetRotation
methods.description: Resets the extrusion rotation around the x-axis and the y-axis to 0 (zero) so that the front of the extrusion faces forward. This method doesn't reset the rotation around the z-axis.

parameters.name: PresetThreeDFormat
parameters.description: Specifies a preset extrusion format that corresponds to one of the options (numbered from left to right, from top to bottom) displayed when you click the 3D Rotation submenu on the Shape Effects menu.

methods.name: SetExtrusionDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction that the extrusion's sweep path takes away from the extruded shape.

methods.name: SetPresetCamera
methods.description: Specifies the effects camera type and rotation to use for the specified ThreeDFormat object.

parameters.name: PresetCamera
parameters.description: The ThreeDFormat object's effects camera type and rotation.

methods.name: IncrementRotationZ
methods.description: Rotates the ThreeDFormat object around the ground plane by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The number of degrees to rotate the ThreeDFormat object, between -180 and 180 degrees.

methods.name: IncrementRotationHorizontal
methods.description: Rotates the ThreeDFormat object along the horizontal axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The number of degrees to rotate the ThreeDFormat object, between -180 and 180 degrees.

methods.name: IncrementRotationVertical
methods.description: Rotates the ThreeDFormat object along the vertical axis by the specified number of degrees.

parameters.name: Increment
parameters.description: The number of degrees to rotate the ThreeDFormat object, between -180 and 180 degrees.
